author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
translation: V. Some one: someone of Sâtvika nature, i.e., of that natural tendency which leads one to virtue and love of God. Him: the Lord who has been spoken of in the first half of the verse 25 The Lord is really marvellous on account of His absolute powers and some one only of Sâtvika nature can think of Him as a wonder, As in the famous simile 'Heavens are like unto heavens,' he thinks of the wonderful Lord by comparing Him to Himself. Hereby it is made clear that none other than the Lord is absolute; and this is the force of the suffix vat.
